title: Ten-sided polynomial tag decoding with 2 entries per side with cumulative side pair caps and cached interpolation contributions

claims.statement: The fixed product of four [500,250] components with length-ten polynomial tags and 2 relative-list entries per side has average block error at most 990633502833604569/1000000000000000000 on the 2000-use BSC(1/10) for uniform 1000-bit data, when decoded by the counted program in proof.md.
The same bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=1144840 primitives for every received word and W<=2^(62896/3125).

experiments.purpose: Verify local tag spectra, exact quotient ranks and cumulative side-cap support profiles in this sector. The last run combines the checked arrays and verifies the exact error and fixed work bounds.
